selection: Frozen 24 frames / 3 scenes; first three native loader questions (one built-in overview template + first two dataset QA). Scope audit separates templates from raw QA; all observations retained.
gate: Proceed to complex M1 scheduling only if actual history-draft verification reduces decode and M3 wall in repeated paired CUDA trials, for at least one separately reported workload. Greedy and sampling are separate gates. No exact deployment if real-model token equivalence fails.
no_go_behavior: Retain raw evidence, verifier and reproduction commands; mark downstream experiments NOT_RUN/null; keep formal config unchanged.
fixed_stream: Repeat the first real question(s) of each scene on subsequent distinct captured frames of that scene; no duplicated images. Diagnostic application workload only.
timing: CUDA event forward kernel spans separately from generation stream spans including host gaps; synchronized wall request measurements. Never infer E2E speedup by adding historical stage costs.
